wiki.title: Susannah Whipps
wiki.extract: Susannah M. Whipps is a member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives, first sworn in on January 7, 2015. A seventh generation resident of Athol, Massachusetts, she was elected as a Republican to represent the 2nd Franklin District, but changed her party affiliation to independent in August 2017. The 2nd Franklin District consists of 12 communities in central and western Massachusetts.
